text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run, because the £400k salary limit could not be checked and the comparison is fragile.

- The options produced almost identical model outcomes; small changes to assumptions could alter the ordering.
- Platform delivery capacity is the most influential model input. Its value is an Olumi estimate, as are all material estimates in this comparison.
- The goal’s direction was not explicitly stated, so the analysis assumed that a higher modelled goal value is preferable; it also could not translate annual salary spend into the same frame as the £400k limit.

This is a provisional model-relative result, not a decision answer.
